    generate(int) - Method in class main.java.benchmarking.inputgeneration.DAGGenerator
    Generates a sparse connected DAG defined as follows : N = `nodeCount` , E = 5 * N, using natural ordering to ensure the graph remains Acyclic.
    generate(int) - Method in class main.java.benchmarking.inputgeneration.DenseGenerator
